name: Gopalganj–Bettiah Highway
facts: Connects the district towns of Gopalganj and Bettiah in north-western Bihar.
Crosses the Gandak plain, which floods most monsoons.
Bettiah is the gateway town for the Valmiki Tiger Reserve on the Nepal border.
The area is one of the most densely populated rural districts in India.
significance: A short national highway across north-western Bihar between Gopalganj and Bettiah, through the Gandak plain. This is flood country — the Gandak and its tributaries cut the district roads most monsoons — so an all-weather highway between the two district towns matters more here than its length suggests.

sources.title: NHAI — National Highways Authority of India
